verdict.rationale: Docs claim automatic provisioning/deprovisioning of access, groups, and permissions on role change or offboarding, and support for SCIM among federated protocols, which directly matches the story; however evidence is entirely vendor-claimed marketing copy with no independent/hands-on confirmation of actual SCIM push mechanics (attribute/entitlement mapping, real-time sync latency, error handling). One doc even claims Rippling avoids traditional 'SCIM lag' entirely, which is inconsistent with a pure SCIM-push story but not a concrete contradiction of the capability itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of SCIM provisioning behavior, detail on entitlement-level sync, and confirmation of real-time push timing beyond marketing claims.
